{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, indicating systematic undershoot that corrects toward mean over time",
    "Sentiment turning negative (below 0) correlates with model undershoot, as model fails to fully incorporate the magnitude of sentiment reversal",
    "When price history shows consolidation around 72-75, model maintains excessive distance from current levels, revealing lag",
    "Sentiment remains positive (above 0.67) during price declines, indicating model over-weights sentiment more than price momentum",
    "Model forecast slope is too flat compared to true outcome trajectory, especially in early 30-day horizons",
    "When sentiment switches from positive to negative, model delay causes initial forecasts to remain inflated relative to rapid true price corrections",
    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains projections too far from recent price levels, especially when true prices have rapidly converged to a range"
] }
